title: CatalogEntity
responsibility: Stores versioned unit metadata in catalog_entities through a supplied persistence adapter.

inputs.name: CatalogEntity.id
inputs.description: Row identity passed to the adapter unchanged; the model never generates it. CatalogWriteService sets it to the SHA-256 hex digest of the stable JSON of the registry unit it stores.

inputs.name: CatalogEntity.unitId
inputs.description: Id of the registry unit the row was built from, in the lowercase dotted or dashed form such as model.catalog-entity. The model passes it on unchanged and does not check it against the registry.

inputs.name: CatalogEntity.version
inputs.description: Version of the registry unit, passed on unchanged. The revision registry sets it to the first 16 hex characters of a SHA-256 digest over the canonical JSON of the unit manifest and its owned source paths with their blobs.

inputs.name: CatalogEntity.kind
inputs.description: Kind of the registry unit, passed on unchanged; the model does not check it against any list of kinds.

inputs.name: CatalogEntity.title
inputs.description: Title of the registry unit, passed on unchanged. The model does not trim, normalize, or check it.

inputs.name: CatalogEntity.responsibility
inputs.description: Responsibility text of the registry unit, passed on unchanged. The model does not trim, normalize, or check it.
examples: Stores versioned unit metadata in catalog_entities through a supplied persistence adapter.

inputs.name: CatalogEntity.data
inputs.description: The registry unit view carried in the data field, typed as RevisionRegistry['units'][number]. The model copies only the top-level attribute object, so data is forwarded by reference and never read or validated.

outputs.name: CatalogEntity.delete

errors.name: Persistence operation failure
errors.description: Synchronous exceptions and promise rejections from the adapter reach the caller unchanged; the model adds no catch, retry, or wrapping.

outputs.name: CatalogEntity.find
outputs.description: Resolves with the row the adapter returns for the table and id, or null when the adapter resolves null. The model returns the adapter's promise without changing the row.
